reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code,
       800 * (1 - discount_pct / 100) AS sale_price_eur,
       800 * (1 - discount_pct / 100) - 520 AS margin_eur,
       ROUND((800 * (1 - discount_pct / 100) - 520) / (800 * (1 - discount_pct / 100)) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM promotions
